text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of the "Summer Training Camp."
Our live-in training camp lifestyle begins at a training facility near the seaside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a great opportunity to dramatically improve her skills
in preparation for the Kikuka Sho, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Living in the dorms means I barely get
any time to myself as it is, and now this—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Training camps just make me gloomy because there's practically zero time free from other people's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, this might be a rather
high-stress environment for Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So, to keep them in peak condition—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, there really isn't anyone here.
I can't believe there was such a hidden gem.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It's quiet...
Seems like a nice spot for a nap too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...So, after running around the moment we got here,
you were just searching for a spot like this?"
choice_data_list: I thought it might bring you some comfort!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry. It's like this every year.
You don't have to go this far—I'll still do my training properly, sheesh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, it's time for training!!
We're doing it, right?!"
choice_data_list: Will do! I'll go get ready!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Timing a 'thank you' is way too hard.
